humanApproval.scope: Pilot quality and framing approved by user; zoom observed as partial and not centered on the node/edge core
humanApproval.historicalReplayLimitation: Original replay compared only camera and one focus node; it did not prove invariance of every graph node. The centered variant freezes and hashes all nodes.
